name: Dry brush / Passe-partout
look: Dry-brush silhouettes of trees and figures in one blue-black ink on grey paper in a black mount, planes tracked on twos, no accent; plate B is the negative

axes.base: flat grey paper (#D3D3D3) inside a black mount with a brushed inner edge; the tooth is in the brush
axes.line: no contour: every shape is a dry-brush silhouette (dryBrushFill) or a dry-brush stroke (dryBrush)
axes.tone: flat fills without tone: three greys of one ink by depth; no hatching, no gradient, no glow, no fog
axes.planB: the negative: the same frame under grade { invert: 1 }, cut inside a held drawing
axes.motion: on twos, each drawing landing one frame ahead of the beat; the near plane boils on the same clock; multiplane tracking
axes.accent: none; the budget guards against the house magenta leaking in
axes.font: thin sans, lower case, tracked, on the mount only
axes.match: silhouette: the figure keeps its outline and place across the cut
